patterns: APPSC asks the publisher of 'Energy Statistics' (CSO) and the per-capita consumption/well-being link as one-line concept items.
Most PSC items on this topic are kWh/unit arithmetic (bulb watts x hours) and unit definitions, not deficit data.
Other PSCs ask 'energy crisis' meaning and solar as second source after fossil fuels.
App is heavily current-data driven (2025-26 peak GW, NGAP, AP roadmap); far deeper than PYQs, which never quote GW figures.
